messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Pager - KestrelHealth (private/vpc) auth failures detected. Spike of TLS handshake failures on tenant bridge; 28% of session creation attempts returning 5xx. Alert: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/PD-1298
oncall-ana: Acknowledged. Who's got recent keystore rotations scheduled for that tenant?
kestrel-support: Support: Kestrel reports new sessions failing about 02:12 UTC. They routed 15% traffic to a fallback region, still seeing errors. Existing sessions unaffected.
infra-raf: I deployed a keystore rotation job to kestrel tenant at 02:07 as part of scheduled quarterly rotation. Logs show import succeeded but with warnings: "certificate chain incomplete, intermediate not present". The job didn't mark as failed due to legacy error handling.
eng-ryan: Observed TLS error in our tenant-bridge: "tls alert unknown_ca" from client handshake. Running `openssl s_client -connect tenant-bridge.kestrel.svc:443 -showcerts` returns only the leaf CERT.
solutions-zoe: Temporary mitigation options: A) Restore last known-good keystore snapshot B) Reconstruct chain by re-adding intermediate from CA archive C) Route traffic to dedicated fallback node with older chain. Which is lowest risk?
security-ops: Note: previous intermediate was rotated out due to compromise-mitigation QRA-2026-07. Restoring old intermediate requires approval and audit annotation. We should confirm no key compromise.
infra-raf: I can restore snapshot quickly. We have s3://keystores/private/kestrel/keystore-prev-2026-09-18.jks with same private key and full chain. Restoration will cause tenant-bridge process restart per node; expect ~60-120s per worker.
oncall-ana: Get me a quick risk call with Security. If approved, proceed canary on 1 worker and measure.
security-ops: Joining. If we restore, we must rotate the intermediate again after fixing the rotation tooling. We'll also run CRL/OCSP checks. Approved for rollback as short-term mitigation with strict window <= 2 hours.
infra-raf: Starting canary restore on worker-2: `aws s3 cp s3://keystores/private/kestrel/keystore-prev-2026-09-18.jks /var/lib/tenant-keystore/keystore.jks && systemctl restart tenant-bridge@worker-2`
incident-bot: Runbook: Tenant keystore rollback - https://runbooks.redwood/tenant-keystore-rollback (v3)
eng-ryan: Canary logs: `2026-10-02T02:23:14Z keystore loaded, certificate chain length: 3` Probing handshake OK from external health probe.
kestrel-support: Kestrel on call confirms session creation success for requests routed to canary worker. They're seeing immediate improvement.
oncall-ana: Proceed rolling to remaining 7 workers, one-at-a-time. Watch for handshake errors and client rejections.
infra-raf: Roll complete 8/8 workers at 02:29 UTC. Observability: session creation 5xx down from 28% to 2% in 4 minutes.
eng-ryan: Collected artifacts: keystore import logs, rotation job stdout, openssl outputs, and worker restart timestamps. Pushing to ticket INC-2026-342.
solutions-zoe: Drafting customer message: "We observed a keystore rotation where the intermediate certificate was not included, causing client mTLS handshakes to fail for new sessions. We restored the previous keystore as an emergency mitigation and will perform a corrected rotation with full chain validation. Estimated full mitigation & validated rotation within 2 hours." Please review + send.
kestrel-support: Please include impact window and what we changed; Kestrel asked about SLA credits. I'll escalate.
security-ops: Action: add CI pre-flight check to rotation tooling to verify full chain and fail the job on missing intermediate. Also add an alert for "keystore import with warnings" to not be silent.
oncall-ana: Post-incident tasks: 1) Keep rollback in place and monitor 30m. 2) Rebuild corrected keystore with validated chain in staging. 3) Run canary rotation with strict rollback. 4) Postmortem and RCA. Assign owners and ETA.
eng-ryan: I'll own corrected rotation verification in staging (INF-4932). infra-raf owns tooling fix (INF-4933). security-ops will run key integrity review (SEC-2104).
incident-bot: Pager status: acknowledged by oncall-ana; escalation paused.
infra-raf: Note: rotation tool suppressed non-fatal warnings; changed flag to --fail-on-warning and added test case. Pushed patch and deployed to prod pipeline.
security-ops: Completed quick integrity scan of the previous intermediate; no signs of compromise. We'll still proceed with planned rotation but with added validation.
solutions-zoe: Customer message sent at 02:36 UTC. Kestrel replied: "Thanks, we'll monitor. Can you share the timeline for corrected rotation?"
oncall-ana: Targeting corrected rotation at 03:15 UTC with canary + rollback. I'll coordinate a short maintenance window with Kestrel.
kestrel-support: Customer acknowledged and on standby.
eng-ryan: Monitoring shows stable TLS success rates and normal latency. I'll keep the bridge metrics on a 10s cadence.
oncall-ana: I'll leave channel open for 45m then mark resolved if no regressions. Great work team. :white_check_mark:
